name: Airport Terminal Sharp Cheddar or Mozzarella String Cheese Stick
whyItWorks: Individually sealed pasteurized cheese sticks in terminal cooler cases. Aged cheddar and part-skim mozzarella have less than 0.1g lactose per stick, providing 6g–7g of clean protein with zero GI distress.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy a pair from the grab-and-go refrigerator before boarding.
